anomalies.observed: On the Microcontroller sheet, D2 is in series with C14 (22uF) between HEATER and GND. The specified series resistor R3 is not shown.
anomalies.expected: D2 should have the specified series resistor R3 for current limiting; C14 should not occupy that series-resistor position.

evidence.quote: A status LED (D2) and series resistor (R3) are also on the HEATER net

anomalies.impact: The series capacitor blocks steady-state DC, so the LED may only flash transiently when HEATER switches rather than indicate that the heater is on. It also does not provide the specified resistor-based LED current limiting.

parsed.summary: The heater-status LED branch differs from the specification: the schematic places C14 (22uF) in series with D2 and omits R3. This is likely to prevent steady heater-on indication and does not provide the specified current-limiting resistor.
